authority: Direct Root bounded decision after reading frozen actions.rs and HANDOFF178.
root_disposition: The existing download-five label represents a request for the next batch of at most five eligible chapters, not a promise of exactly five remaining chapters or five jobs.

source_anchors.selection: Filter after current progress and not downloaded, then take(count); an empty eligible set returns no_downloads_needed.

original_visual_observation_preserved: The current image shows three chapters, two unread and one downloaded. No download action was triggered in this capture.
consequence: Do not create a product defect or source change from the label versus total chapter count. Only a real same-source operation exceeding eligibility/cap or selecting the wrong book would require a new finding.
remaining_scope: Actual download job counts and live-reader CacheLease qualification remain tied to their separate retained same-source operation/external records, not to this unclicked screenshot.
